raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview Moves MiniMax-M3's InferenceX AgentX lanes for H200, B200 (both keys) and B300 out of guide sections and into opt-in **presets**, so recipes.vllm.ai and its JSON API render each qualified point. Today the guide tells readers to change the generated command by hand. Builds on vllm-project/recipes#1162 (presets) and vllm-project/recipes#1175 (per-point `tp`), both merged. ## Claims - Four opt-in presets, 23 points total, each with the lane's image digest, InferenceX key, and builder choices (GQA draft, text-only, thinking always on) as data: | Preset | Variant | Points | |---|---|---| | `h200_agentx` | mxfp8 | 8 | | `b200_agentx` | nvfp4 | 4, TP4, host KV offload on three | | `b200_agentx_c10` | nvfp4 | 6, active-sequence caps, incl. a TP8 point | | `b300_agentx` | nvfp4 | 5, TP8/TP4/TP2 | - Per-point settings come from the lane tables and are rendered as flags rather than prose: - `--max-num-seqs`, `--max-num-active-seqs`, capture sizes and memory utilization; - host KV offload (1,073 GB / 749 GB, lazy); - the MSA decode backend dropped where the lane omitted it; - draft token count, local-argmax removal and all-reduce backend. - No existing rendering changes: the presets are opt-in. - The guide loses the three lane sections (about 120 lines). Each preset's runbook keeps the lane description, the recipe-wide **Verified** caveat and the synthetic-acceptance note. ## Validation - `node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir /recipes` passes against recipes main (fdf035b). - Rendered every preset point (`/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3/presets/.json`) and checked 16 points programmatically against the lane tables. They matched on: - TP, `--max-num-seqs`, `--max-num-active-seqs` and capture size; - memory utilization and KV offload bytes / lazy; - MSA flag, `num_speculative_tokens`, local-argmax reduction, all-reduce backend and image. - All 254 existing renderings across the four variants (`MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3`, `-MXFP8`, `nvidia/…-NVFP4`, `amd/…-MXFP4`) are identical to main apart from `guide` / `presets`. - Builder check on B300: - picking the preset switches to NVFP4 with GQA, text-only and thinking; - points switch TP 8 → 2 → 4; - the TP2 point turns KV offload on (749 GB) and the TP4 point turns it off; - the hint reads "4 of 8 GPUs"; - state survives a reload. ## Details - **Opt-in:** these are benchmark lanes (fixed client counts, synthetic-acceptance throughput runs), so the builder's defaults stay the recipe's own. The variants' existing B200/B300 blocks, which already carry the lanes' shared flags, are untouched. - **CUDA graph sizes:** the B200 lane passed `--cudagraph-capture-sizes`; the presets set the same list as `cudagraph_capture_sizes` in `--compilation-config`, as the B300 lane does. vLLM maps the former onto the latter (they are mutually exclusive), and the JSON form keeps the YAML readable. - **Thinking always on** follows the B200 lane's command, which passes `--default-chat-template-kwargs '{"thinking_mode":"enabled"}'` (the old builder steps omitted it). - **Not in this PR:** - the GB200 Dynamo lane: aggregated Dynamo serving isn't a builder option yet; - the MI355X MXFP4 benchmark section: it has eval and throughput arms. That is a follow-up. ---
Pull Request Checklist - [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

@@ -4,7 +4,7 @@ meta:
   provider: "MiniMax"
   description: "MiniMax M3 vision-language MoE (427B total / 26B active) for frontier coding, agent toolchains, and 1M-token reasoning via MSA sparse attention — native multimodal (image + video + computer use); BF16 plus MXFP8, NVIDIA Blackwell NVFP4, and AMD MI355X MXFP4 variants. Runs on NVIDIA (Hopper/Blackwell) and AMD CDNA4/CDNA3."
   date_added: 2026-06-12
-  date_updated: 2026-10-23
+  date_updated: 2026-10-25
   tasks:
     - text
     - multimodal
@@ -365,6 +365,256 @@ strategy_overrides:
           - "--attention_config.indexer_kv_dtype"
           - "fp8"
 
+# Tuned presets (SCHEMA.md): the InferenceX AgentX lanes, each a delta on the
+# baseline command for one GPU and variant. All are opt-in: the builder's
+# defaults stay the recipe's own; pick a preset (and a point) to render a lane.
+presets:
+  h200_agentx:
+    label: "AgentX TP8"
+    hardware: h200
+    strategy: single_node_tp
+    variants: [mxfp8]
+    workload: "Agentic (InferenceX AgentX)"
+    description: "One 8-GPU H200 node, TP8, with the GQA EAGLE3 draft (three tokens) and thinking always on; the scheduler batch is twice the client count."
+    source: { label: "InferenceX #4429", href: "https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4429", key: "minimaxm3-fp8-h200-vllm-agentic-mtp" }
+    image: "vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-83c078d955cd6e0c63d3b12abe669c8de936a370@sha256:cb12c3016938a4ee98ed176ac833984089460689a0982cff4b5a60bb45b3cded"
+    select:
+      features: { spec_decoding: eagle3_gqa, text_only: true, thinking_always_on: true }
+    # The lane passes these; the builder's MXFP8 command does not.
+    args: ["--trust-remote-code", "--block-size", "128"]
+    # --max-num-seqs is twice the client count; the CUDA graph capture size covers
+    # it at four tokens per sequence (the sequence plus three draft tokens).
+    points:
+      c1: { label: "1 client", concurrency: 1, args: ["--max-num-seqs", "2", "--max-cudagraph-capture-size", "8"] }
+      c2: { label: "2 clients", concurrency: 2, args: ["--max-num-seqs", "4", "--max-cudagraph-capture-size", "16"] }
+      c4: { label: "4 clients", concurrency: 4, args: ["--max-num-seqs", "8", "--max-cudagraph-capture-size", "32"] }
+      c6: { label: "6 clients", concurrency: 6, args: ["--max-num-seqs", "12", "--max-cudagraph-capture-size", "48"] }
+      c8: { label: "8 clients", concurrency: 8, args: ["--max-num-seqs", "16", "--max-cudagraph-capture-size", "64"] }
+      c10: { label: "10 clients", concurrency: 10, args: ["--max-num-seqs", "20", "--max-cudagraph-capture-size", "80"] }
+      c12: { label: "12 clients", concurrency: 12, args: ["--max-num-seqs", "24", "--max-cudagraph-capture-size", "96"] }
+      c14: { label: "14 clients", concurrency: 14, args: ["--max-num-seqs", "28", "--max-cudagraph-capture-size", "112"] }
+    runbook: |
+      The H200 AgentX lane in [SemiAnalysis InferenceX](https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/) (`minimaxm3-fp8-h200-vllm-agentic-mtp`, [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4429](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4429)) serves the MXFP8 checkpoint with the GQA EAGLE3 draft (three speculative tokens) as one aggregated vLLM worker on a single 8-GPU H200 node: TP8, no expert parallelism, no host KV offload.
+
+      The InferenceX throughput points replaced block verification with synthetic rejection at the committed golden EAGLE3-GQA acceptance length (2.78 for MiniMax-M3 with three draft tokens, thinking on; [`minimaxm3_eagle3_gqa.yaml`](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/main/inferencex-e2e/infx/golden_al_distribution/minimaxm3_eagle3_gqa.yaml)) so every point is measured at the same acceptance rate. The command above does not set it.
+
+  b200_agentx:
+    label: "AgentX TP4"
+    hardware: b200
+    strategy: single_node_tp
+    variants: [nvfp4]
+    workload: "Agentic (InferenceX AgentX)"
+    description: "TP4 on four of the node's eight B200 GPUs with the GQA EAGLE3 draft (three tokens, local argmax reduction); the larger points add host KV offload."
+    source: { label: "InferenceX #4382", href: "https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4382", key: "minimaxm3-fp4-b200-vllm-agentic-mtp" }
+    image: "vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-af7f9488c2210d67e1033ecdc845b087ee7fe92b@sha256:8e2ffbb9f866de678b22e7446903b1ee5a5766c51a948013277477c462a68a77"
+    tp: 4
+    select:
+      features: { spec_decoding: eagle3_gqa, text_only: true, thinking_always_on: true }
+    # The variant's B200 block already carries the lane's shared flags (prefix
+    # caching, 16384 batched tokens, 0.95 memory, autotune off, stream interval).
+    points:
+      # Concurrency 15 and 32 leave the MSA decode backend at the image default.
+      c15:
+        label: "15 clients"
+        concurrency: 15
+        args: ["--max-num-seqs", "30", "--max-cudagraph-capture-size", "120"]
+        remove_args: ["--attention_config.minimax_m3_msa_decode_backend"]
+        select: { kv_offload: "off" }
+      c30:
+        label: "30 clients · KV offload"
+        concurrency: 30
+        args: ["--max-num-seqs", "60", "--max-cudagraph-capture-size", "4096"]
+        select: { kv_offload: simple }
+        env: { VLLM_USE_SIMPLE_KV_OFFLOAD: "1" }
+        json_args:
+          "--kv-transfer-config": { kv_connector_extra_config: { cpu_bytes_to_use_per_rank: null, cpu_bytes_to_use: 1073000000000, lazy_offload: true } }
+          "--compilation-config": { cudagraph_capture_sizes: [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64, 72, 80, 88, 96, 104, 112, 120, 128, 136, 144, 152, 160, 168, 176, 184, 192, 200, 208, 216, 224, 232, 240, 256, 320, 384, 448, 512, 640, 768, 896, 1024, 1280, 1536, 1792, 2048, 2560, 3072, 3584, 4096] }
+      c32:
+        label: "32 clients · KV offload"
+        concurrency: 32
+        args: ["--max-num-seqs", "64", "--max-cudagraph-capture-size", "256"]
+        remove_args: ["--attention_config.minimax_m3_msa_decode_backend"]
+        select: { kv_offload: simple }
+        env: { VLLM_USE_SIMPLE_KV_OFFLOAD: "1" }
+        json_args:
+          "--kv-transfer-config": { kv_connector_extra_config: { cpu_bytes_to_use_per_rank: null, cpu_bytes_to_use: 1073000000000, lazy_offload: true } }
+      c38:
+        label: "38 clients · KV offload"
+        concurrency: 38
+        args: ["--max-num-seqs", "76", "--max-cudagraph-capture-size", "4096"]
+        select: { kv_offload: simple }
+        env: { VLLM_USE_SIMPLE_KV_OFFLOAD: "1" }
+        json_args:
+          "--kv-transfer-config": { kv_connector_extra_config: { cpu_bytes_to_use_per_rank: null, cpu_bytes_to_use: 1073000000000, lazy_offload: true } }
+          "--compilation-config": { cudagraph_capture_sizes: [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64, 72, 80, 88, 96, 104, 112, 120, 128, 136, 144, 152, 160, 168, 176, 184, 192, 200, 208, 216, 224, 232, 240, 248, 256, 272, 288, 304, 320, 384, 448, 512, 640, 768, 896, 1024, 1280, 1536, 1792, 2048, 2560, 3072, 3584, 4096] }
+    runbook: |
+      The B200 AgentX lane in [SemiAnalysis InferenceX](https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/) (`minimaxm3-fp4-b200-vllm-agentic-mtp` and `minimaxm3-fp4-b200-vllm-agentic-mtp-c10`, [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4382](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4382)) serves the NVFP4 checkpoint with the GQA EAGLE3 draft as one aggregated vLLM worker on a single 8-GPU B200 node. Most points run TP4; the concurrency-10 arm also has a TP8 point.
+
+      The host-KV-offload points pin 1,073 GB of host memory for KV blocks across the node (lazy offload).
+
+      The **Verified** badge for this GPU is recipe-wide. This preset covers the NVFP4 variant only; the GQA draft override in `features.spec_decoding` also applies to the other variants on this GPU, which were not qualified.
+
+      The InferenceX throughput points replaced block verification with synthetic rejection at the committed golden EAGLE3-GQA acceptance length so every point is measured at the same acceptance rate. Production serving keeps the default rejection sampler, as in the command above.
+
+  b200_agentx_c10:
+    label: "AgentX active-seq caps"
+    hardware: b200
+    strategy: single_node_tp
+    variants: [nvfp4]
+    workload: "Agentic (InferenceX AgentX)"
+    description: "Caps the sequences the scheduler keeps active (--max-num-active-seqs) well below the client count, with a five- or three-token GQA draft without local argmax reduction."
+    source: { label: "InferenceX #4382", href: "https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4382", key: "minimaxm3-fp4-b200-vllm-agentic-mtp-c10" }
+    image: "vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-ac7509e2b1db40fec2f03dde1ed4e9dfdc2338c9@sha256:98adb2311118263a453ec0acd5d4b72bda3db26cecc0fe8ffc94b9ab03c951f9"
+    tp: 4
+    select:
+      features: { spec_decoding: eagle3_gqa, text_only: true, thinking_always_on: true }
+    env: { VLLM_FLASHINFER_ALLREDUCE_BACKEND: "mnnvl" }
+    json_args:
+      "--speculative-config": { use_local_argmax_reduction: null }
+    # --max-num-seqs stays at its default; every point sets --max-cudagraph-capture-size
+    # to the last of its capture sizes.
+    points:
+      c10_tp4:
+        label: "10 clients · TP4"
+        concurrency: 10
+        args: ["--max-num-active-seqs", "1", "--gpu-memory-utilization", "0.925", "--max-cudagraph-capture-size", "4096"]
+        select: { kv_offload: "off" }
+        json_args:
+          "--speculative-config": { num_speculative_tokens: 5 }
+          "--compilation-config": { cudagraph_capture_sizes: [1, 2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36, 40, 44, 48, 52, 56, 60, 64, 68, 72, 76, 80, 84, 88, 92, 96, 100, 104, 108, 112, 116, 120, 124, 128, 132, 136, 140, 144, 148, 152, 156, 160, 164, 168, 172, 176, 180, 184, 188, 192, 196, 200, 204, 208, 212, 216, 220, 224, 228, 232, 236, 240, 244, 248, 252, 256, 272, 288, 304, 320, 336, 352, 368, 384, 400, 416, 432, 448, 464, 480, 496, 512, 640, 768, 1024, 1536, 2048, 3072, 4096] }
+      c10_tp8:
+        label: "10 clients · TP8"
+        concurrency: 10
+        tp: 8
+        args: ["--max-num-active-seqs", "1", "--gpu-memory-utilization", "0.9", "--max-cudagraph-capture-size", "4096"]
+        remove_args: ["--disable-flashinfer-autotune"]   # FlashInfer autotune on at this point
+        select: { kv_offload: "off" }
+        json_args:
+          "--speculative-config": { num_speculative_tokens: 5 }
+          "--compilation-config": { cudagraph_capture_sizes: [1, 2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36, 40, 44, 48, 52, 56, 60, 64, 68, 72, 76, 80, 84, 88, 92, 96, 100, 104, 108, 112, 116, 120, 124, 128, 132, 136, 140, 144, 148, 152, 156, 160, 164, 168, 172, 176, 180, 184, 188, 192, 196, 200, 204, 208, 212, 216, 220, 224, 228, 232, 236, 240, 244, 248, 252, 256, 272, 288, 304, 320, 336, 352, 368, 384, 400, 416, 432, 448, 464, 480, 496, 512, 640, 768, 1024, 1536, 2048, 3072, 4096] }
+      c20_a4:
+        label: "20 clients · 4 active"
+        concurrency: 20
+        args: ["--max-num-active-seqs", "4", "--gpu-memory-utilization", "0.9", "--max-cudagraph-capture-size", "8192"]
+        select: { kv_offload: simple }
+        env: { VLLM_USE_SIMPLE_KV_OFFLOAD: "1" }
+        json_args:
+          "--speculative-config": { num_speculative_tokens: 3 }
+          "--compilation-config": { cudagraph_capture_sizes: [1, 2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36, 40, 44, 48, 52, 56, 60, 64, 68, 72, 76, 80, 84, 88, 92, 96, 100, 104, 108, 112, 116, 120, 124, 128, 132, 136, 140, 144, 148, 152, 156, 160, 164, 168, 172, 176, 180, 184, 188, 192, 196, 200, 204, 208, 212, 216, 220, 224, 228, 232, 236, 240, 244, 248, 252, 256, 272, 288, 304, 320, 336, 352, 368, 384, 400, 416, 432, 448, 464, 480, 496, 512, 640, 768, 1024, 1536, 2048, 3072, 4096, 6144, 8192] }
+          "--kv-transfer-config": { kv_connector_extra_config: { cpu_bytes_to_use_per_rank: null, cpu_bytes_to_use: 1073000000000, lazy_offload: true } }
+      c20_a3:

-  ## H200: InferenceX AgentX aggregated (vLLM)
-
-  The H200 AgentX lane in [SemiAnalysis InferenceX](https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/) (`minimaxm3-fp8-h200-vllm-agentic-mtp`, [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4429](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4429)) serves the MXFP8 checkpoint with the GQA EAGLE3 draft (three speculative tokens) as one aggregated vLLM worker on a single 8-GPU H200 node: TP8, no expert parallelism, no host KV offload. It ran on `vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-83c078d955cd6e0c63d3b12abe669c8de936a370@sha256:cb12c3016938a4ee98ed176ac833984089460689a0982cff4b5a60bb45b3cded` (vLLM `0.32.1rc1.dev361`). The command builder keeps its own pinned H200 MXFP8 image, an earlier nightly; use the image above to reproduce these points.
-
-  In the command builder, pick **H200** and the **MXFP8** variant (the builder keeps the current variant when you switch hardware, so select MXFP8 explicitly), turn on **Spec Decoding → GQA**, **Text-only** and **Thinking Always On**, and use **Single-node TP**. On an 8-GPU H200 node the builder sizes TP to 8. That renders every serving flag and environment variable below except the per-point `--max-num-seqs` and `--max-cudagraph-capture-size`, which stay in this guide. The lane does not set `--max-model-len`.
-
-  Every point uses `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.95`, which the builder already sets for H200. The scheduler batch is twice the client count, and the CUDA graph capture size covers it at four tokens per sequence (the sequence plus three draft tokens):
-
-  | Clients | `--max-num-seqs` | `--max-cudagraph-capture-size` |
-  |---:|---:|---:|
-  | 1 | 2 | 8 |
-  | 2 | 4 | 16 |
-  | 4 | 8 | 32 |
-  | 6 | 12 | 48 |
-  | 8 | 16 | 64 |
-  | 10 | 20 | 80 |
-  | 12 | 24 | 96 |
-  | 14 | 28 | 112 |
-
-  ### Command
-
-  ```bash
-  VLLM_MARLIN_USE_ATOMIC_ADD=1 \
-  vllm serve MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3-MXFP8 --tensor-parallel-size 8 --trust-remote-code \
-    --attention-backend FLASH_ATTN --linear-backend humming --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
-    --attention-config '{"indexer_kv_dtype":"fp8"}' --block-size 128 --enable-prefix-caching \
-    --speculative-config '{"method":"eagle3","model":"Inferact/MiniMax-M3-EAGLE3-GQA","num_speculative_tokens":3,"attention_backend":"FLASH_ATTN"}' \
-    --max-num-seqs <S> --max-cudagraph-capture-size <N> --gpu-memory-utilization 0.95 --language-model-only \
-    --reasoning-parser minimax_m3 --tool-call-parser minimax_m3 --enable-auto-tool-choice \
-    --default-chat-template-kwargs '{"thinking_mode":"enabled"}'
-  ```
-
-  The lane passes `--trust-remote-code`; the builder's MXFP8 command does not.
-
-  The InferenceX throughput points replaced block verification with synthetic rejection at the committed golden EAGLE3-GQA acceptance length (2.78 for MiniMax-M3 with three draft tokens, thinking on; [`minimaxm3_eagle3_gqa.yaml`](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/main/inferencex-e2e/infx/golden_al_distribution/minimaxm3_eagle3_gqa.yaml)) so every point is measured at the same acceptance rate. The command above does not set it.

   ## GB200: InferenceX AgentX aggregated (Dynamo + vLLM)
 
   The GB200 AgentX lane in [SemiAnalysis InferenceX](https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/) (`minimaxm3-fp4-gb200-dynamo-vllm-agentic-agg-mtp`, [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4281](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4281)) serves the NVFP4 checkpoint with the GQA EAGLE3 draft (three speculative tokens) as one aggregated vLLM worker behind the Dynamo frontend's KV-aware router. TP4 runs on one 4-GPU GB200 tray; TP8 spans two trays. Image `vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-5555a2d8f7116b2b4877f66516f4128176cf722a@sha256:8896fd7b29fc4ee7ce839f146cb4757984c476ec79d0234ffa8c995dee6e339a`, Dynamo `1.6.0.dev20261016` (`pip install ai-dynamo==1.6.0.dev20261016`).
